It stays in Files and simply stops being referenced (Langify keys translations off the URL, so nothing is renamed or overwritten — scripts/upload-theme-images.py, rule 7). THE MASTER IS SQUARE, AND THAT IS THE RULE FOR THIS SECTION, NOT A CHOICE. In media-with-text the row height is max(text column, image natural height) and .media-with-text__media carries no aspect-ratio of its own, so a non-square master stretches its grid row and the block stops matching its five siblings. The five other blocks on this page are square; this master is 2048x2048, so the row is unchanged. No object-position rule is needed: the subject sits centre-frame with margin on all four sides, so the side-crop that happens around 1000-1150 viewport width takes background, not product or label. WEB LOADING — MEASURED, NOT ASSUMED. The live for this block declares sizes '(max-width: 999px) 100vw, min(720px, 50vw)' and a srcset topping out at 1000w. So the largest derivative the theme ever asks for is 1000px, and a 2048px master is headroom, not weight — the CDN generates and serves the derivative, never the master. Source encoding was tested rather than ritually re-compressed: at 4:4:4 progressive, q80 gives 364KB, q85 410KB, q88 441KB, q90 474KB against the source's 383KB. Every usable quality is LARGER than the file already is, so re-encoding would cost label sharpness and buy nothing. Metadata is already clean (0 bytes EXIF, 0 bytes ICC). Uploaded as-is; delivered bytes verified against the CDN at the real srcset widths after upload, because the CDN is what a visitor downloads (shopify-cdn-makes-source-compression-pointless).
